objective: Test whether parameter-efficient weight training improves feedback-conditioned executable-skill revision on task-family-disjoint evaluation, beyond the same base model using context-only RSI.
current_evidence_boundary: The current CARE 2.0 loop updates prompts, external memory, hypotheses, and executable skills. It does not update model weights. Any weight-trained result is a new experimental arm and must not be merged silently with context-only RSI.

smoke_test.claim: Pipeline and schema-conformance validation only; no efficacy or generalization claim.
smoke_test.target: Normalized executable-skill JSON from valid archived responses.

candidate_recipe_after_hardware_inventor.base_model: TBD after A800 GPU count, memory, local model inventory, and license check
candidate_recipe_after_hardware_inventor.selection: Validation-task JSON validity first, then development AUC; never heldout-task AUC

attribution_requirements: trained adapter must improve over the frozen base model under the same prompts and reveal budget
trained adapter with true feedback must improve over its no-feedback and shuffled-feedback controls
the improvement direction must replicate on task families excluded from training and checkpoint selection
